How to play

A quick guide to the board and controls.

Move piecesClick a piece, then a highlighted square — or drag it directly.
Rotate cameraDrag on an empty area, or use the toolbar presets.
PanRight-drag or two-finger drag.
ZoomScroll wheel or pinch gesture.
ReviewClick any move in the move history to revisit the position.
ShortcutsN new game · U undo · R redo · F flip · Esc close dialogs

The engine uses classical alpha-beta search, transposition tables, quiescence and a tapered evaluation. It is inspired by the philosophy of Deep Blue, not a reproduction of its hardware or strength.
